pages.text: $(d)Plasmids$() are the vehicle that carries $(l:geneticsresequenced:genes)Genes/$.$(br2)Plasmids default as $(c)empty$(), with no genetic information.$(br2)To begin, use a $(l:geneticsresequenced:blocks/plasmid_infuser)Plasmid Infuser/$ to infuse a decrypted DNA Helix into them.$(br2)This will set the Plasmid's Gene.
Plasmids require a certain amount of $(9)Gene Points$() to be complete.$(br2)The amount of Gene Points required depends on the Plasmid's Gene. $(9)More advanced Genes cost more Points.$()

This Plasmid has been infused with the $(l:geneticsresequenced:genes/scare_creepers)Scare Creepers/$ Gene.$(br2)Notice, however, that it $(c)only contains 1 Gene Point$().$(br2)Infusing more DNA Helices of the same Gene will add +2 Points each, while Basic Genes will add +1 each.

Once it's reached its maximum Gene Points required, the Plasmid will be marked $(9)complete$()!$(br2)That means it's ready to be injected into a Syringe at the $(l:geneticsresequenced:blocks/plasmid_injector)Plasmid Injector/$.
